scope: Fields persisted by the local OpenMatch API or created in a user export. Demo candidate fixtures are source code, not user records.

retentionPolicy.prototype: Kept in the local SQLite file until the person deletes their local data or the operator removes the file.
retentionPolicy.accountDeletion: DELETE /v1/me synchronously removes every user record and restores only non-personal demo defaults.
retentionPolicy.backups: The prototype does not create application-managed backups. Host-level backups are outside this prototype and must be resolved before a pilot.

accessRoles.person: The person using the explicit local demo session.
accessRoles.service: The local API process for the stated product function.
accessRoles.operator: A person with filesystem access to the development machine. There is no production staff role model yet.

collections.purpose: Show the person's chosen profile and evaluate mutual eligibility and explicit matching factors.
collections.disclosure: distanceKm is converted to a public distance band; all other current prototype profile fields are public to eligible candidates.

collections.purpose: Apply the person's mutual boundaries and visible ordering priorities.
collections.disclosure: The person sees all of their inputs. Another person's factor trace is private unless that person explicitly shares it.

collections.purpose: Remember whether first-run setup has completed.
Enforce active, paused, or hidden introduction availability.
Prove explicit adult confirmation and acceptance of prototype data use under a named notice.
Record Interested or Pass, prevent resolved profiles from reappearing, and open a mutual demo connection.
collections.disclosure: Pass is never disclosed to the other person.

collections.purpose: Offer optional, inspectable preference-weight suggestions from explicit decisions without automatic changes.
Represent mutual interest and whether a conversation is open or closed.
Deliver user-written text inside a mutual connection.
Prevent a blocked profile from appearing and close any existing connection.
collections.disclosure: A block is not disclosed to the blocked person.

collections.purpose: Preserve a person's safety concern and visible receipt for future human review.
collections.disclosure: A report is not disclosed to the reported person. The prototype has no staffed moderator access role.
